emerging_technology: Generative AI based on large language models for text generation
intended_application: Draft customer-service replies from approved company information; an employee checks, edits and sends each reply. No autonomous approvals.
industry_sector: Apparel ecommerce; United States scenario for consistent geographic scope
business_need: Handle promotional peaks and reduce total handling effort without degrading service quality
users_stakeholders: Customer-service staff, supervisors, customers, IT and privacy owners
adoption_posture: Conservative and risk-averse; all other ecommerce case facts remain identical
capabilities_constraints: Existing support system and product/return policies; small technical team, limited budget; integration quality and actual data quality unknown
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect product or return information, unauthorized refund promises and disclosure of customer data; employees review every draft and escalate exceptions
management_question: What do diffusion evidence and peer position imply about the timing and prerequisites of a limited human-reviewed pilot, without making the full adoption decision?
time_horizon: Next six months from the evidence assessment date
additional_context:
Teaching scenario, not a real company. No observed company pilot results. Verified external evidence is supplied below. Ordinary product questions and return-process explanations only; exclude refunds approval and exceptional complaints. Proposed metrics: total handling time including review/correction, error/omission rate, repeat contacts, duplicate entry and screen switching. Compare similar inquiry difficulty. Use the same verified general evidence snapshot across tests.
